rules.name: Beacon-style configuration block (unencrypted)
rules.description: The documented TLV header of an unencrypted Cobalt-Strike-style beacon configuration: 0001 0001 0002 xxxx 0002 0001 0002 (public threat-research reporting).

rules.name: Beacon-style configuration block (XOR 0x2e)
rules.description: The same TLV header XOR-encoded with the single byte 0x2e used by 4.x-era beacons (public reporting).

rules.name: Beacon-style configuration block (XOR 0x69)
rules.description: The TLV header XOR-encoded with 0x69, used by older beacons (public reporting).

rules.name: Default post-exploitation named-pipe templates
rules.description: Public default pipe-name templates (msagent_, MSSE-...-server, postex_, status_) seen in beacon builds and loaders.

rules.name: Default beacon runtime strings
rules.description: Format strings from public beacon analyses: '%s as %s\%s: %d', 'beacon.dll' and ReflectiveLoader together.

rules.name: Meterpreter payload strings
rules.description: metsrv and stdapi extension strings with the reflective loader export, as documented in public Metasploit source.

rules.name: x86 shellcode: public block_api stager prologue
rules.description: The prologue shared by many Metasploit x86 stagers: cld; call; pushad; mov ebp,esp; xor edx,edx; mov edx,fs:[edx+0x30].

rules.name: x64 shellcode: public stager prologue
rules.description: cld; and rsp,-16; call: the x64 Metasploit-style stager prologue (fc 48 83 e4 f0 e8 ?? 00 00 00 41 51 41 50 52).

rules.name: Sliver-style implant package strings
rules.description: Go package path fragments from the public Sliver implant (sliverpb, implant/sliver) in a compiled binary.

rules.name: Tunnelling tool banners
rules.description: Strings of public tunnelling tools: chisel, ligolo, dnscat2 and iodine.
